exclusions.reason: Authored exclusion of foreground globular cluster identified in registered optical image; not SMC gas.

depthInterpretation: Authored dominant conditional ray-mode hypothesis. Select the strongest prior mode per image component and assign its complete projected weight there. Not a recovered gas depth; no duplicated secondary-mode feature or artificial bridge. Two-scale variant: smoothed image light is carried along the simulation's own density (envelope); finite components fit only the remaining detail. Ellipsoid variant: the envelope follows the VMC-constrained ellipsoid hypothesis, which scores better against the red-clump observations than the simulation, instead of the Garver simulation.
